Maturity is not the only reason a category is not on the form -- a category every one of whose settings needs a z axis is not on a flat laboratory microplate's form either -- and two functions each calling ``setVisible`` on the same card is how a card comes back the next time Preferences is saved. So the dimension switches are answered here as well, and the settings search hands visibility back to this method for the same reason. records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen.refresh_maturity_visibility#1
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)
records.source: ALSO THE ONE PLACE A SECTION'S VISIBILITY IS DECIDED. Maturity is not the only reason a category is not on the form -- a category every one of whose settings needs a z axis is not on a flat plate's form either -- and two functions each calling ``setVisible`` on the same card is how a card comes back the next time Preferences is saved. So the dimension switches are answered here as well, and the settings search hands visibility back to this method for the same reason. A heading the object rule holds back, because the run has none of its objects, stays hidden here too.
records.translation: OCKSÅ DET ENDA STÄLLE DÄR ETT AVSNITTS SYNLIGHET AVGÖRS. Mognad är inte det enda skälet till att en kategori inte finns i formuläret -- en kategori där varenda inställning kräver en z-axel finns inte heller i en platt plattas formulär -- och två funktioner som båda anropar ``setVisible`` på samma kort är hur ett kort kommer tillbaka nästa gång Preferences sparas. Därför besvaras dimensionsbrytarna här också, och inställningssökningen lämnar synligheten tillbaka till den här metoden av samma skäl. En rubrik som objektregeln håller tillbaka, eftersom körningen inte har några av dess objekt, förblir dold även här.

records.context: On a CPU the weights are loaded in float32. records.context: One widget, two owners. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow microscope field of view the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.segmentation_views#1
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)
records.source: ONE WIDGET, TWO OWNERS. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow field the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.translation: EN WIDGET, TVÅ ÄGARE. En segmenteringsförhandsvisning har fyra saker som är värda att titta på: bilden med konturerna på, etikettmaskerna för sig, flödesfältet som maskerna samlades ur, och cellsannolikheten som flödet trösklades vid. Maskgenereringens direktförhandsvisning visade tre av dem via en rullgardinsmeny; plackförhandsvisningen visade sina egna fyra via flikar, ritade av sin egen kod. Den här modulen är det enda ställe som båda kan rita dem från, så att en ändring av hur en cellsannolikhet färgas når båda förhandsvisningarna på en gång.

records.context: What an owner can change. The default renderers draw a plain overlay, categorical masks, the flows as Cellpose hands them and the probability on the magma scale. An owner with its own idea of an outline -- the live preview's colour choice and thickness -- registers a renderer for that view with :meth:`SegmentationViews.set_renderer` and keeps the other three. A renderer answers with a picture, with a sentence to show in the picture's place, or with ``None`` for the widget's own "nothing yet" sentence.
